label: nx_moving_guide_010
text:
You can bring Pokémon over from Pokémon Bank
for Nintendo 3DS systems.

label: nx_moving_guide_011
text: Pokémon brought over from the Nintendo 3DS can’t be sent back!

label: nx_moving_guide_012
text:
Before moving Pokémon, please check the mobile device version of
Pokémon HOME to see which Pokémon can be moved to which games.

label: nx_moving_guide_020
text:
Select “Move Pokémon to Pokémon HOME” in
Pokémon Bank for Nintendo 3DS systems.
Then input the Moving Key.

label: nx_moving_guide_021
text:
Pokémon HOME can’t be used until
the Moving Key has expired.

label: nx_moving_msg_010
text:
Warning! You’ll be unable to use Pokémon HOME until the
move is complete.[RETURN]
Do you want to begin move preparations?

label: nx_moving_msg_020
text:
Select a Box in the “Move Pokémon to Pokémon HOME”
option in Pokémon Bank for Nintendo 3DS systems.[CLEAR]
Then proceed to the screen where you can enter the
Moving Key.

label: nx_moving_msg_025
text:
You may be using an outdated version of Pokémon Bank.
Please update to the most recent version.[CLEAR]
If you have any questions, please consult the
Pokémon HOME official website.

label: nx_moving_msg_030
text:
Moving Keys are only valid for three minutes. Enter the
key into Pokémon Bank as soon as you can.[CLEAR]
Once a Moving Key is active, you won’t be able to go
back until it expires.[CLEAR]
Do you want to create a Moving Key?

label: nx_moving_msg_040
text:
Your Pokémon HOME Boxes are full! Please make some space
and try again.

label: nx_moving_msg_050
text:
Pokémon Bank data found! Move preparations will begin.[CLEAR]
You’ll be unable to use Pokémon HOME until the move
is complete.

label: nx_moving_msg_060
text:
If you’re having trouble, please consult the Pokémon HOME
official website.

label: nx_moving_msg_070
text:
The Moving Key has been entered in Pokémon Bank
successfully! Move preparations will begin.[CLEAR]
You’ll be unable to use Pokémon HOME until the move
is complete.

label: nx_moving_msg_090
text:
Check for a Nintendo Network ID that used Pokémon Bank
connected to this user’s Nintendo Account?

label: nx_moving_msg_100
text:
The move will begin automatically if data is
successfully found.[CLEAR]
All Pokémon from Pokémon Bank will be moved to
Pokémon HOME.[CLEAR]
You’ll be unable to use Pokémon HOME until the move
is complete.[CLEAR]
Are you sure you want to search for a Nintendo Network ID
and begin the move?

label: nx_moving_msg_0110
text:
Checking for Pokémon Bank data...
Please wait.

label: nx_moving_msg_0130
text:
Unable to find Pokémon Bank data that can be moved.
Please check the connection to your Nintendo Network ID.[CLEAR]
After verifying the connection to your Nintendo Network ID,
wait a little while before trying again.

label: nx_moving_immigrate_msg_010
text:
Move preparation is complete.
There [CTRL:1101:0000,0302]isare [CTRL:0203:0000,002C] Pokémon that can be moved![CLEAR]
How would you like to move [CTRL:1101:0000,0402]itthem to Boxes in
Pokémon HOME?

label: nx_moving_immigrate_msg_020
text:
The Pokémon in the Pokémon Bank Boxes will be moved
as is.[CLEAR]
Do you want to save your progress?

label: nx_moving_immigrate_msg_025
text:
The Pokémon in the Pokémon Bank Boxes will be moved one
at a time to fill open spaces.[CLEAR]
Do you want to save your progress?

label: nx_moving_immigrate_msg_030
text:
Now saving...
Please don’t close Pokémon HOME.

label: nx_moving_immigrate_msg_040
text:
You saved your progress![CLEAR]
Pokémon were moved from Pokémon Bank to your Boxes
in Pokémon HOME!

label: nx_moving_immigrate_msg_045
text:
You received [CTRL:0203:0000,002C] Pokémon HOME points for moving for
the first time!

label: nx_moving_immigrate_msg_050
text:
You need [CTRL:0202:0000] more vacant Box[CTRL:1101:0000,0200]es!
Do you want to organize your Boxes?

label: nx_moving_help_010
text:
Bringing Pokémon over from Pokémon Bank on
Nintendo 3DS systems is called moving!

label: nx_moving_help_020
text:
Choose Begin Move and enter the Moving Key
in Pokémon Bank to move your Pokémon over to Pokémon HOME!

label: nx_moving_help_030
text:
A Moving Key is only valid for a little while, so make sure to enter it
before time runs out!
What’s more, while the key is being displayed, you can’t use the other
features of Pokémon HOME! Golly!

label: nx_moving_help_035
text:
Neat-o! This is a fun tidbit! When you move Pokémon from
Pokémon Bank, the Pokédex data from Pokémon Bank is carried
over, too!

label: nx_moving_help_040
text:
Well, gee whiz! If there’s anything you don’t understand about moving
or if you don’t have your Nintendo 3DS with you, try checking out the
Pokémon HOME official website!
